rules.accepted_credit_types: Providers approved by the board under 201 KAR 20:220; DEA- or SAMHSA-approved groups for the 8-hour substance use disorder training; 1 contact hour = 50 minutes
rules.new_licensee_rule: APRNs holding an RN privilege and first licensed after July 15, 2024 complete the one-time topics within 3 years of licensure.
rules.alternatives: Instead of 14 hours: current national certification/recertification related to the practice role (plus the required pharmacology and one-time topics), or research/publication/preceptorship, or 7 hours plus a satisfactory employment evaluation.
rules.audit_note: Random audits; records kept 5 years and uploaded via the nurse portal within 20 days of request.

topics.who: APRNs registered with the DEA and holding a PDMP account (pain management or addiction disorders, within the 5 pharmacology hours)
APRNs with a DEA registration, before the next scheduled DEA registration

rules.notes: Annual earning period Nov 1 - Oct 31. One-time topics: 1.5 h pediatric abusive head trauma, 3 h domestic violence and elder abuse, 1 h dementia (current licensees by Oct 31, 2027), 2 h suicide prevention; those done by July 15, 2024 need not be repeated.
rules.rule_quote: Section 3. Methods for continued competency validation as established in subsection (1) through (4) of this section shall be: (1) Fourteen (14) contact hours of continuing education, which shall: (a) Be from a provider approved by the board pursuant to 201 KAR 20:220; (b) Be completed during the earning period;…
